title: Learning Chinese
summary: A foreign student talks about two years of studying Chinese.

sentences.zh: 我叫安娜，我学了两年汉语了。
sentences.en: My name is Anna, and I've been learning Chinese for two years.

sentences.zh: 开始的时候，我觉得汉语很难。
sentences.en: At the beginning, I thought Chinese was very hard.
There are lots of characters, and I often wrote them wrong.

sentences.zh: 老师说话说得很快，我听不懂。
sentences.en: The teacher spoke very fast, and I couldn't understand.

sentences.zh: 但是我每天都学习一个小时，还跟中国朋友一起说汉语。
sentences.en: But I studied for an hour every day and spoke Chinese with Chinese friends.

sentences.zh: 现在我说得不错了，老师说什么我都能听懂。
sentences.en: Now I speak quite well, and I can understand everything the teacher says.

sentences.zh: 我已经会写五百多个汉字了。
sentences.en: I can already write over five hundred characters.

sentences.zh: 虽然汉语很难，但是很有意思。
sentences.en: Although Chinese is hard, it's very interesting.

sentences.zh: 明年我想去中国学习，我希望能说得跟中国人一样好。
sentences.en: Next year I want to study in China; I hope to speak as well as a Chinese person.

questions.prompt: How long has Anna been learning Chinese?
why: Right: 我学了两年汉语了.
One hour is how long she studies each day.

questions.prompt: What was hard for her at the beginning?
why: Right: she wrote characters wrong and couldn't understand the fast speech.
She had Chinese friends to practise with.

questions.prompt: How many characters can she write now?
why: It's 五百多, not 五千.

questions.prompt: What does she want to do next year?
why: Right: 明年我想去中国学习.
She wants to study, not teach.
She says Chinese is interesting and wants to go on.
